setup_line: Load the bar evenly and use collars. If you lift in a rack, set the safety arms just below the lowest point of the rep.
Pick dumbbells you can control for every rep, and use a matching pair unless the exercise is single-sided.
Set the pulley to the height the exercise needs and step back so the weight stack is lifted before your first rep.
Adjust the seat and pads so the joint you are moving lines up with the machine's pivot, then set a weight you can control.
No equipment is needed. Choose a version you can do with clean form for your target reps, and make it easier or harder by changing the leverage.
Inflate the ball firmly and put it on a non-slip floor; expect to need more control than on a bench.
Load the EZ bar evenly and grip the angled sections so your wrists sit in a comfortable position.
Pick a kettlebell you can control, and keep it close to your body as you move.
